sources.summary: OpenAI 于 10 月 27 日宣布其 AI 模型在数学、计算机科学和物理学领域取得三项研究突破。数学上给出了所有维度下局部光滑猜想的证明，从而解决挂谷猜想与斯坦因限制猜想；计算机科学上给出推翻指数时间假设（ETH）的证明，暗示相关计算任务可能有更快算法；物理学上提出量子色动力学及标准模型一种统一完备化的严格存在性证明，涉及杨–米尔斯千禧年难题的一部分。

en.title: OpenAI says its AI model has achieved three scientific breakthroughs, spanning the local smoothing conjecture, the exponential time hypothesis, and Yang–Mills theory
en.summary: On October 27, OpenAI announced that its AI model had achieved three research breakthroughs in mathematics, computer science and physics. In mathematics, it produced a proof of the local smoothing conjecture in all dimensions, resolving the Kakeya conjecture and Stein's restriction conjecture; in computer science, it produced a proof refuting the exponential time hypothesis (ETH), suggesting related computational tasks may have faster algorithms; in physics, it proposed a rigorous existence proof for a unified completion of quantum chromodynamics and the Standard Model, bearing on part of the Yang–Mills Millennium Prize Problem.
en.reason: OpenAI said on October 27 its AI model proved the all-dimension local smoothing conjecture, refuted the exponential time hypothesis, and supplied a four-dimensional QCD and pure Yang–Mills existence proof, with the first two Lean-verified and physics awaiting review.

sources.title_zh: Hugging Face CEO 转评前 DOGE 研究人员用 AI 智能体渗透 Anthropic 系统事件
sources.title_en: If you were thinking concentrating AI behind closed doors is safe, it is time to update your priors!
sources.title_original: If you were thinking concentrating AI behind closed doors is safe, it is time to update your priors!
sources.summary: Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue 转引《华盛顿邮报》独家报道并评论称，认为把 AI 集中在封闭大门后就是安全的想法需要更新认知。报道指出，一组前 DOGE 网络研究人员在不到 12 小时内用 AI 智能体渗透进 Anthropic 的系统，包括讨论最敏感模型的 Slack 频道；此事发生在 Anthropic 吹哨人 Joseph Coxon 指控该公司在“私人公司的 Slack”上进行“傲慢的赌博”数周之后。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章围绕把 AI 集中封闭在闭门之后是否安全展开，直言若你仍相信闭门开发更安全，就该 update your priors，并邀请读者查看最新动态、加入这场讨论。

en.summary: Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue shared The Washington Post’s exclusive report and said the belief that keeping AI behind closed doors makes it safe needs a rethink. The report said a group of former DOGE cyber researchers used AI agents to infiltrate Anthropic’s systems in under 12 hours, including Slack channels where its most sensitive models were discussed. It came weeks after Anthropic whistleblower Joseph Coxon accused the company of making an “arrogant gamble” on “a private company’s Slack.
en.reason: A Washington Post report cited by Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue says former DOGE researchers used AI agents to infiltrate Anthropic’s systems, including a Slack channel discussing its most sensitive models, in under 12 hours.
